entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi For the Petitioner :Mr. Vinay
Kumar Tiwary, Advocate For the State : Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra,

A.P.P. 02/ 05.01.2026: Heard
learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sector-IV, P.S. Case No. 101 of 2020,
registered under sections 406 and 420 of I.P.C, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M, Bokaro.
3.

By way of referring Annexure-2, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier Complaint Case No. 1468 of 2019 has been lodged by the complainant and for the same allegation present F.I.R. has been lodged.
He further submits that in the said complaint case the petitioner has been granted bail by the learned court.
On these grounds, he submits that the petitioner may kindly be provided privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that allegations of taking money and not returning the same are there.

5. Further, on query made by the Court, learned counsel for the State fairly submits that same allegations are there in the F.I.R.

sentences.text: In view of above and considering that for the same allegation the present F.I.R has been lodged and the petitioner has already been ( 2026:JHHC:27 ) granted bail in the said complaint case, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the above named, petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/-
(twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M, Bokaro, in connection with Sector-IV, P.S. Case No. 101 of 2020, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 482 (2) of B.N.S.S, 2023.

Dt.05.01.2026 ( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.)
